name: rotating-mountain-climber
instructions:
1. Assume a plank pushup position with your hands underneath your shoulders.
2. Drive one knee towards the opposing elbow until the hip reaches 90 degrees of flexion.
3. Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Assume a plank pushup position with your hands underneath your shoulders. 2. Drive one knee towards the opposing elbow until the hip reaches 90 degrees of flexion.
